text_block_list.text:
With Rose Kingdom in a bit of a slump lately,
I brought her to a shrine to offer our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Praying to the gods and Buddhas, is it...?
While turning to prayer in times of distress is customary...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is a bitter humiliation. To think that over my own affairs,
I must resort to praying to heaven.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: In such a wretched state, can I truly claim to aspire to the throne...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. You guided me here fully aware of that, didn't you? In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
O Lord, pray look upon me struggling in adversity...
Upon me... gasping under hardship...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (—No, as the leader of the Rose Clan, how could I ever seek salvation for myself alone?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: In that case, here—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: O Lord, pray grant Thy divine protection unto all those who gasp under hardship, even as I do.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Lend me the strength to break free from these briars.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes... As expected, I could not bring myself to pray for mere personal desires. But...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I did beg for it. A grand salvation, that is.
(*Vrooom!*)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...
I feel as though my heart has grown a bit lighter.
Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Bottling up my troubles within
may have been a poor choice in itself.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, Trainer. You have my thanks.
That was a wonderful change of pace.
The effect was immediate. A rosy vitality returned to Rose Kingdom's cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I did beg for it. A grand salvation, that is.
choice_data_list_en: And... did you get any blessings?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I feel nothing in particular. But...
perhaps this is for the best.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: If offering a prayer can spare someone like me from suffering, then that is enough.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The thorns upon me...
For a time, I shall make this pain my companion
and press forward.
